codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes, Ordinance Requirements
findings.comment: Note stating "All improvements shall be made in accordance with the released site plan. Any additional improvements will require a site plan amendment and approval from the Development Services Department" is missing from the cover sheet. This required note appears on Sheet 3 (General Notes) but must also be present on the cover sheet per UCM 2.5.1(E) and General Site Plan Notes requirements.

Case number SP-2025-0126C is present only on Sheet 1 (Cover sheet) with 3 instances displayed. The case number is absent from all other 38 sheets (Sheets 2-39 of 39). Case number must appear on all sheets of the plan set including site plan, landscape, elevation, architectural, and all supplemental sheets.

Case number placement in lower right corner cannot be verified for sheets 2-39 because the case number is not present on those sheets. Verification requires the case number to first appear on all sheets per ZLU-29.20.

Case number inclusion in approval block File Number field cannot be verified for sheets 2-39 because approval blocks on those sheets either do not display the case number or are not present. Sheet 1 approval block correctly shows FILE NUMBER SP-2025-0126C, but other sheets require verification once case number is added per ZLU-29.20.

Case number legibility cannot be assessed for sheets 2-39 because the case number is absent from those sheets. On Sheet 1, the case number is fully legible in all four locations; however, full legibility verification across all sheets is not possible without the case number being present on all sheets.

Jurisdictional type code (SP, SPC, CT, CP, or CX) cannot be verified from the submitted documents. Case number shows SP-2025-0126C; however, the applicability of this format to the DSD intake designation (whether this is administratively approvable SP or conditional SPC) is not documented in the plan set or supplementary documents reviewed. Intake database records and case type determination required.

Cover sheet does not include a Related Cases section. No designated box or section listing applicable zoning cases, subdivision cases, prior site plan approvals, tree permits, license agreements, or other legal documents is present on the cover sheet.

Related Cases section does not list applicable zoning case numbers. Zoning Case No. C14-2011-0093 appears in the Site Development Data table (Block 6) but is not included in a dedicated Related Cases section on the cover sheet. The Related Cases section is missing entirely.

Related Cases section does not list applicable subdivision case number or Austin Water subdivision file number. Subdivision File No. C8S-75-160 is shown in the Site Development Data table but is not properly listed in a Related Cases section on the cover sheet. The Related Cases section is missing.

Related Cases section does not list prior site plan approval case number. Prior site plan SP-97-0145CS (Southwood Nursing Care Center Addition, approved 1997) exists for this property but is not listed in a Related Cases section on the cover sheet. The Related Cases section is missing entirely.

Related Cases section does not list tree permit case numbers. A Commercial Tree Permit was filed (2025-08-14) and is applicable to this project but is not listed in a Related Cases section on the cover sheet. The Related Cases section is missing.

Engineer's report does not include the correct case number. The Engineer's Summary Letter header (dated April 4, 2025) identifies the project as "Valley View Townhomes, 3759 Valley View Road, Austin, Texas 78704" but does not cite the site plan case number SP-2025-0126C. Case number must be included in all project correspondence and reports.
